assumptions.statement: All site and key-area polygons are provisional rough geometry derived from the repository package.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: All spatial relationships and area calculations may change.
assumptions.mitigation: Replace geometry and regenerate layers, figures, metrics and HTML after official data arrives.

assumptions.statement: No formal regulatory controls, ownership, existing-building survey or municipal capacity are available.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Building scale, phasing and renewal choices may change.
assumptions.mitigation: Keep FAR, height, density and retain/renovate/demolish decisions unknown or conceptual.

assumptions.statement: All ten scenario cards are conceptual public-experience propositions, not deployed services.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Some scenarios may not pass later technical or legal review.
assumptions.mitigation: Use human review, stop conditions, rollback and non-AI alternatives.

assumptions.statement: The package figures are original schematic diagrams derived from package geometry and proposal text.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: A visual asset may require replacement if a source or rights issue is found.
assumptions.mitigation: Do not add third-party photos, fonts or logos without a rights record.

assumptions.statement: Operators, procurement, maintenance contracts and funding are intentionally not fixed at concept stage.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Later delivery responsibilities may require redesign.
assumptions.mitigation: Describe roles and evidence responsibilities only; confirm with professional teams and authorities.

assumptions.statement: Official boundary or taskbook updates trigger a package-wide recalculation.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Stale metrics or drawings could mislead review.
assumptions.mitigation: Record source version, rerun self-check and refresh manifest hashes.

assumptions.statement: This global online submission uses network evidence as a temporary substitute for site observation; no interviews or site visits are claimed.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Some access, comfort, accessibility and service claims may change after field verification.
assumptions.mitigation: Record source grade, retrieval date and limits, then replace with field evidence when available.
